description: Return NavMDs' curated city guide for a procedure: the ranked specialists (the city's OWN doctors first, then the nearest within an adaptive radius), the typical local price range, the average rating, the share offering free consultations, and the canonical navmds.com page URL to cite. This is the best tool for 'who are the best <procedure> doctors in <city>' questions — it mirrors NavMDs' editorial city pages. If no curated guide exists for that city+procedure, it says so; fall back to search_doctors with a nearby larger city.

city.description: City name, e.g. 'Beverly Hills', 'Miami'. This is the area the user asked about, not the user's own location.

state.description: US state name, e.g. 'California', 'Florida'. This is the area the user asked about, not the user's own location.

name: find_local_specialists
title: Curated 'best {procedure} doctors in {city}' guide
